verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada documents named delegated-access roles, "full access manager" and "filing collaborator", along with a corporation key and a "Manage shared access and permissions" function for filing annual returns. It also refers to registered intermediaries filing on a corporation's behalf. The evidence does not spell out what each role may or may not do, and nothing is published on authorization forms or on which signatures must stay personal. Missing for 10: published authorization/consent forms, per-role permission boundaries, rules on non-delegable personal signatures or attestations, independent corroboration.
